digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 finder, model resolution in ProductionBatchRunner
propositions: Pass-1 finder silently downgraded from frontier/opus to trivial/haiku after b690, making the blocking gate more permissive without alarm
Before b690, PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config so model_ladder declarations never influenced Pass-1; b690 made declarations reachable but found trivial in YAML
Archaeological evidence shows 115 plan-review runs on opus before 2026-06-27, zero since, confirming the downgrade was a regression not a design choice
model_ladder rung 0 must be frontier/opus for Pass-1 finder to restore intended behavior while Pass-2/Pass-4 remain on standard/sonnet per _verifier_cfg
Prerequisite finder packs bins against cfg.model which resolves to haiku window after the regression, causing premature context-limit escalation
